[PREFERENCE] User decided to start with a simple stone pendant.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on selecting the right type of stone for beginners, recommending soft stones with a Mohs hardness of 3-5, including:
1. Soapstone
2. Alabaster
3. Calcite

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised against using hard stones with a Mohs hardness of 6 or higher.

[PREFERENCE] User is thinking of using soapstone for their pendant project.

[PREFERENCE] User likes the soft, earthy look of soapstone and appreciates that it is relatively inexpensive.
